rows.result: robots.txt allows public product, collection, page, and blog content, blocks transactional/crawl-trap paths, and references https://winn-foods.com/sitemap.xml.
robots.txt references /sitemap.xml, but GSC lists an old /sitemap_index.xml submission and a /page-sitemap.xml with 1 error, 2 warnings, 11 submitted web URLs, and 0 indexed.
rows.next_action: Submit the current Shopify /sitemap.xml in GSC, remove obsolete submissions, and resolve the page-sitemap error/warnings.

rows.result: GSC and GA4 expose inconsistent/legacy paths and variants, including HTTP/www homepages, parameterized product URLs, 'currly', 'chuttak', '100g-copy', //products, /wp-login.php, and unrelated-looking legacy paths.
rows.next_action: Create a URL cleanup map, 301 obsolete/typo handles to canonical replacements, remove bad internal links, and investigate unrelated paths.

rows.result: Navigation and contextual links were observed, but the bounded 20-page crawl cannot prove that no orphan URLs exist or that every key page is within three clicks.
rows.next_action: Run a complete crawl with link graph/depth and reconcile it against sitemap, GSC, and GA4 URL inventories.

rows.result: The available evidence did not include a complete redirect-chain and broken-link export.
rows.next_action: Run a full crawler redirect report for all internal links, including HTTP/www and legacy handles.

rows.result: Sampled live pages use clean HTTPS self-canonicals, but GSC still reports impressions for HTTP, www, and parameterized product variants, showing unresolved duplicate discovery/index signals.
rows.next_action: Enforce one HTTPS non-www host, 301 alternate hosts, canonicalize parameters, and remove parameterized URLs from internal discovery.

rows.result: Search Analytics proves that 64 URLs earned impressions, but it cannot prove complete indexation or absence of accidental noindex; a complete Page Indexing/URL Inspection set was unavailable.
rows.next_action: Export GSC Page Indexing coverage and inspect representative homepage, collection, product, blog, recipe, and anomalous URLs.
